title: Success Pathway: Cadence, Triggers & 0-90 Day Template
content:
Purpose: Quick, repeatable success pathway for new customers that ties operational cadence (meetings/tasks) to measurable signals for expansion and renewal. This is a modular 0-30 / 31-60 / 61-90 template that CS can copy into customer folders and adapt per contract.

High-level principles (single page):
- Start with a single "quick win" in week 1 that demonstrates product value.
- Instrument concrete, measurable adoption signals (usage, feature depth, time-to-first-success).
- Use a rolling 14-day review cycle to surface blockers early.
- Tie quantitative signals to qualitative check-ins for early risk detection.
- Every customer has an "activation owner" for the first 90 days; handoff to AM happens with a one-pager + risk/expansion summary.

Pre-Start checklist (Before Day 0):
- Contract / SOW confirmed and project kickoff scheduled (Owner: AM)
- Provisioning complete: API keys, tenant creation, initial dataset uploaded (Owner: Ops/Onboarding)
- Shared kickoff deck and checklist sent to customer "Day 0" invite (Owner: Activation Owner)
- Tracking sheet created in CS folder and product instrumentation ticket opened (Owner: Activation Owner)

0-30 (Goal: activation + one demonstrable value):
- Cadence: Weekly 30-45m touchpoints (Weeks 1, 2, 3, 4) + async notes in shared doc
- Objectives: 1) Achieve first successful production call (or feature flow) 2) Confirm mapping of product features to customer's top 2 use cases
- Key results (examples): 1) 1+ production-flagged request per day for 3 consecutive days; 2) Customer can run evaluation prompt set and see baseline metrics
- Tasks & owners:
  - Day 0 Kickoff: review roles, timeline, success metrics (Owner: Activation Owner)
  - Week 1: Quick win config + test harness (Owner: Solutions Eng)
  - Week 2: Integration review + performance baseline (Owner: EngSWE or Solutions)
  - Week 3: Fine-tune routing/throughput suggestions (Owner: Activation Owner)
  - Week 4: Adoption review, remaining blockers, renewal/expansion early signals (Owner: Activation Owner + AM)
- Success criteria to mark "Activated": quick-win in live tenant AND documented baseline metrics in tracker
- Risk signals: repeated test failures, infra provisioning gaps, customer no-shows for >2 consecutive meetings

31-60 (Goal: consistent usage + feature breadth):
- Cadence: Biweekly check-ins and a deeper 60-day review call (45-60m)
- Objectives: 1) Drive daily active usage across 1+ business workflow 2) Evaluate early quality/regression signals
- Key results (examples): 1) DAU/requests growth to target threshold; 2) Error rate and latency within agreed SLOs
- Tasks & owners:
  - Week 5-6: Measure adoption across user cohorts, tag heavy users (Owner: Activation Owner + Analytics)
  - Week 7: Cost/perf tuning recommendations (batching, cache profile) (Owner: Optimize Team / Solutions)
  - Week 8: Feature enablement (functions/tool calling, structured outputs) and training session for power users (Owner: CS Trainer)
- Success criteria to mark "Adopted": steady usage and one documented expansion opportunity OR roadmap ask captured
- Risk signals: plateauing request volumes, repeated quality regressions, unresolved SLO breaches

61-90 (Goal: value realization + renewal positioning):
- Cadence: Monthly cadence after day 60, renewal readiness call at ~day 80
- Objectives: 1) Demonstrate ROI or operational impact 2) Create renewal or expansion plan
- Key results (examples): 1) 90-day business KPI delta (e.g., reduction in time-to-serve, increased throughput) 2) Signed statement of continued value or expansion intent
- Tasks & owners:
  - Week 9-10: Business impact review with stakeholder metrics (Owner: AM + Activation Owner)
  - Week 11: Formal renewal health assessment and playbook for at-risk accounts (Owner: AM)
  - Week 12: Customer success one-pager + handoff to AM (Owner: Activation Owner)
- Success criteria to mark "Mature": AM has renewal confidence score >= target OR an expansion pilot is scheduled
- Renewal triggers: usage thresholds + stakeholder alignment + competitive monitor flagged

Meeting agenda templates (copyable):
- Day 0 Kickoff (30m): Intros, success metrics, timeline, immediate blockers, next steps
- Weekly Sync (30-45m): Progress vs KR, technical blockers, action items, owner updates
- 60-day Review (60m): Baselines, adoption trends, performance review, expansion/next steps
- Renewal Readiness (30-45m): Health score, contract cadence, exec alignment, commercial asks

Success Metric bank (examples to pick from):
- Technical: avg latency, 95th pct latency, error rate, token cost per successful request
- Adoption: DAU/MAU, feature penetration (percent of users using advanced feature), retention cohort
- Business: avg handle time reduction, conversion lift, content generation throughput gains

Quick Renewal & Expansion Tracker snippet (to copy into sheet):
- Customer | ARR | Start Date | Current 90d Usage | Health Score (0-100) | Expansion Oppty | Next Steps | Owner
- AcmeCorp | $120k | 2024-10-15 | 12k requests | 78 | Pilot multi-region | Marina Cho

Escalation path (for first 90 days):
- Tier 1: Activation Owner handles day-to-day (responses within 24h)
- Tier 2: Solutions Eng / SE if integration/perf issues (response within 48h)
- Tier 3: SRE / Infra for platform incidents (on-call routing)
- Communication templates in shared folder (incident, blocker, customer-failure postmortem)

Handoff checklist to AM (required at day 90 or earlier if healthy):
- One-page summary: activation timeline, baseline metrics, outstanding risks, exec sponsor contact
- Recorded 60-day review link + deck
- List of potential expansion use cases + rough ARR impact estimate
- Technical runbook and access list (keys, webhooks, dashboards)

Notes on instrumentation and signals (practical tips):
- Use lightweight telemetry first: counts of successful requests, error classes, latency buckets. Avoid expensive full traces for initial 30 days.
- Tag events with "onboarding-customer-id" so we can roll up signals automatically.
- Create simple dashboards for the Activation Owner with: success rate, avg latency, unique users, and top 5 error messages.

Playbook snippets (copy into customer docs):
- "If usage stalls for two weeks": trigger a focused troubleshooting session, share a short list of potential causes (credentials, dataset mismatch, prompt drift), propose 3 prioritized actions, and set a 7-day recheck.
- "If quality regresses": run evaluation suite vs. baseline prompt set, capture top 5 diffs, escalate to model-onboarding with reproducible examples.

Open questions & TODOs (this doc):
- Define exact health-score algorithm (weighting for usage vs. quality vs. stakeholder engagement).
- Standardize "quick-win" examples per industry vertical and create 3 templates (SaaS, marketplace, media).
- Automate creation of the renewal tracker row from provisioning step.

Appendix: Copy-ready one-pager template (single paragraph + bullets for AM handoff)
- Paragraph: short summary of business value delivered during onboarding, the primary production flow enabled, and the top two recommended commercial actions.
- Bullets: baseline metrics, outstanding technical debt, expansion opportunities, exec sponsor and day-to-day owner.

Intended next steps for CS team:
1) Pilot this template on 3 medium-sized accounts this quarter (owners: Marina, Priya).
2) Capture telemetry examples and build basic dashboard template (owner: Analytics).
3) Iterate health-score and publish final version in Confluence (owner: CS Ops).

-- End of draft --
